test_title: PYST 18: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 11 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

My friend has gone to Kerala on vacation, but I have no special plans. I will stay home and ______.
solution:
The correct answer is '**goof off**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**goof off**" means to relax or waste time in a casual, unproductive way, which fits the context of staying home without any specific plans.
 
• Option 1, "**slip up**," means to make a mistake, which does not fit the context of staying home without plans.
 
• Option 3, "**pitch in**," means to help or contribute, which is unrelated to the context of staying home casually.
 
• Option 4, "**iron out**," means to resolve or clarify something, which doesn't fit the idea of simply staying at home with no special plans.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"My friend has gone to Kerala on vacation, but I have no special plans. I will stay home and **goof off**__."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "slip up"** is incorrect because it refers to a mistake, which is not relevant to the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: "pitch in"** is incorrect because it implies helping or contributing, which is not the intended meaning in this sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "iron out"** is incorrect because it refers to resolving or clarifying something, which does not match the casual tone of the sentence.
